concerns.text: Task T017c applies Benjamini-Hochberg correction to p-values, but the Plan (Statistical Rigor) and Spec (SC-001) require Newey-West standard errors (HAC) to correct for autocorrelation in residuals R(n) BEFORE calculating p-values. T017c lacks a task to implement HAC correction, leaving SC-001 and SC-005 unfulfilled.

Task T016a defines 'prime_gap_size' with inconsistent logic (distance to next prime for primes vs. gap size for composites), violating Spec FR-004 which requires a single consistent 'distance to nearest prime' predictor. No task exists to normalize this feature or implement the consistent metric required by FR-004.

Task T004 saves primes to 'code/utils/primes.npy' and updates state checksums there. The Constitution (Principle III: Data Hygiene) and Plan forbid storing derived/processed data in 'code/'. No task exists to move this artifact to 'data/raw/' or 'data/processed/' and update the checksum in the correct location, violating Constitution Principle III.

Task T012 exports partition counts to 'data/raw/partitions_raw.csv'. The Plan and Constitution distinguish 'Raw' (immutable source) from 'Derived' (computed) data. Since these counts are computed, they are 'Derived'. No task exists to save this to 'data/processed/' instead, violating Constitution Principle III.

Task T024 triggers a 'failure' and 'model re-specification' if CV R^2 < 0.05. Spec SC-002 defines R^2 >= 0.05 as a success criterion for the *result*, not a hard runtime constraint. No task exists to handle the case where R^2 < 0.05 as a valid (but weak) scientific finding with a report note, contradicting the exploratory nature of the research (Spec Assumption 5).

Task T004 contains unresolved claim markers '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_e43dc5aa — status=not_enough_info]' and '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_70425371 — status=not_enough_info]' which are not valid task descriptions and indicate missing implementation details for the sieve and DP logic.
